title: Detailed pear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Shadow/base -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="26" ry="5" fill="#1a3a1a" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Main pear body - bottom round part -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="27" ry="24" fill="#8BC34A"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="27" ry="24" fill="#9CCC65" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Highlight on body -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="62" rx="12" ry="14" fill="#AED581" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="58" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#C5E1A5" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Left shadow shade -->
  <path d="M23 68 Q23 85 40 90 Q30 82 28 68 Z" fill="#7CB342" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Upper neck part of pear -->
  <path d="M38 52 Q35 42 36 34 Q38 26 50 24 Q62 26 64 34 Q65 42 62 52 Q58 56 50 56 Q42 56 38 52 Z" fill="#8BC34A"/>
  <path d="M38 52 Q35 42 36 34 Q38 26 50 24 Q62 26 64 34 Q65 42 62 52 Q58 56 50 56 Q42 56 38 52 Z" fill="#9CCC65" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Neck highlight -->
  <path d="M42 50 Q40 40 41 33 Q44 27 48 26 Q44 32 43 40 Q43 46 45 51 Z" fill="#AED581" opacity="0.8"/>
  
  <!-- Blend between top and bottom -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="18" ry="8" fill="#9CCC65" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- Stem -->
  <path d="M49 24 Q48 18 47 14 Q46 11 48 10" stroke="#6D4C41" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M49 24 Q48 18 47 14" stroke="#8D6E63" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Little leaf -->
  <path d="M48 15 Q54 10 58 12 Q55 16 49 16 Z" fill="#66BB6A"/>
  <path d="M48 15 Q54 10 58 12 Q55 16 49 16 Z" fill="#81C784" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M50 14 L56 12" stroke="#43A047" stroke-width="0.5" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Subtle speckles/dots on pear body -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="72" r="1" fill="#A5D6A7" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="76" r="1.2" fill="#A5D6A7" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="80" r="0.9" fill="#A5D6A7" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="64" r="1" fill="#A5D6A7" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="60" r="0.8" fill="#A5D6A7" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="82" r="1.1" fill="#A5D6A7" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="75" r="0.7" fill="#A5D6A7" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Deeper green spot for dimension -->
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="74" rx="5" ry="7" fill="#7CB342" opacity="0.4"/>
